Given $△ABC$ shown above, which of the following diagrams represents the height corresponding to $\overset{―}{AC}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The height (or altitude) corresponding to $\overset{―}{AC}$ is a line segment that 

- runs from the opposite vertex $B$ to the line $\overset{⟷}{AC},$ and

- is perpendicular to $\overset{⟷}{AC}.$

The correct diagram is shown below:
